nodes.label: Ipamorelin
nodes.drug_class: ghrelin receptor (GHSR-1a) agonist / selective GH secretagogue
nodes.approval: not approved; phase 2 development for postoperative ileus abandoned

nodes.label: Ghrelin receptor GHSR-1a
nodes.tissue: anterior pituitary somatotroph; enteric neurons and gastric smooth muscle

nodes.label: GHRH receptor (GHRHR)
nodes.note: not an ipamorelin target; included for family contrast

nodes.label: IGF-1 elevation
nodes.note: not observed in Johansen 1999 rat study (total IGF-1 and IGFBPs unchanged)

nodes.label: Accelerated gastric emptying / increased gastric contractility
nodes.mechanism: ghrelin-receptor mediated via cholinergic excitatory neurons

nodes.label: Increased food intake and body-weight gain
Increased bone mineral content / longitudinal bone growth
nodes.note: tibial areal BMD up; total and vertebral areal BMD unchanged

nodes.label: Appetite stimulation / weight gain (on-target orexigenic effect)
Reduced insulin sensitivity / raised fasting glucose
nodes.strength: strong class evidence (MK-677 RCT); not measured for ipamorelin long-term

nodes.label: Fluid retention / oedema / arthralgia
nodes.strength: inferred from GH-axis class; not quantified for ipamorelin

nodes.label: Theoretical neoplasia risk from sustained IGF-1 elevation
nodes.strength: theoretical; observational IGF-1 epidemiology only; no carcinogenicity study

nodes.label: Immunogenicity from aggregation or peptide-related impurities
nodes.strength: FDA-documented concern specific to compounded ipamorelin acetate; unnatural amino acids complicate characterization

nodes.label: No long-term human safety data (max published exposure ~7 days IV)
Completed 320-patient phase 2 never reported results (publication-bias gap)
HPG axis suppression
nodes.note: does not apply - ipamorelin acts on the GH axis, not the HPG axis

nodes.design: phase 2 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled proof-of-concept; IV twice daily, postoperative day 1 to day 7 or discharge, after small or large bowel resection (NCT00672074, sponsor Helsinn)
nodes.outcome: NEGATIVE: median time to first tolerated meal 25.3 h vs 32.6 h placebo, p=0.15; no significant efficacy differences. TEAEs 87.5% ipamorelin vs 94.8% placebo
nodes.label: Phase 2 postoperative ileus RCT 2014

nodes.design: phase 2, three ipamorelin arms + placebo, recovery of GI function within 10 days after bowel resection; start Apr 2011, completed May 2014
nodes.outcome: UNKNOWN - registry status completed, no results posted and no publication identified; development discontinued
nodes.label: NCT01280344 (completed, unpublished)

nodes.n: 8 healthy male subjects per dose level (dose escalation)
nodes.design: intravenous PK/PD study with population modelling
nodes.outcome: terminal half-life ~2 h; clearance 0.078 L/h/kg; Vss 0.22 L/kg; dose-proportional; GH peak ~0.67 h; inter-individual PD variability exceeded PK variability
nodes.label: Gobburu 1999

nodes.design: rat pituitary cell assay and in vivo GH release
nodes.outcome: high GH-releasing potency, similar to GHRP-6 in pituitary cells; GH-release selectivity resembling GHRH - basis of 'first selective GH secretagogue'
nodes.label: Raun 1998

nodes.n: adult female rats, 4 dose groups (0/18/90/450 ug/day)
nodes.design: three-times-daily dosing for 15 days; tetracycline band distance in proximal tibial metaphysis
nodes.outcome: longitudinal bone growth induced; total IGF-1, IGFBPs and serum bone turnover markers UNCHANGED
nodes.label: Johansen 1999

nodes.n: 13-week-old female Sprague-Dawley rats; ipamorelin / GHRP-6 / GH / vehicle arms
nodes.design: osmotic minipump, continuous infusion, 12 weeks; DXA
nodes.outcome: bone mineral content increased; tibial areal BMD increased; total and vertebral areal BMD unchanged
nodes.label: Svensson 2000

nodes.outcome: ipamorelin counteracted the glucocorticoid-induced decrease in bone formation
nodes.label: Glucocorticoid bone-formation study 2001

nodes.design: rodent postoperative ileus model, IV single vs repeated dosing, GHRP-6 comparator
nodes.outcome: single dose shortened time to first bowel movement but no change in cumulative fecal output, food intake or weight gain at 48 h; repeated dosing increased all three
nodes.label: Venkova 2009

nodes.design: rodent postoperative ileus; gastric emptying and gastric smooth muscle
nodes.outcome: accelerated gastric emptying by stimulating gastric contractility via ghrelin-receptor mechanism involving cholinergic excitatory neurons
nodes.label: Greenwood-Van Meerveld 2012

nodes.design: 2-year double-blind randomized placebo-controlled modified-crossover trial, oral MK-677 25 mg/d, healthy adults 60-81 (class evidence, different molecule)
nodes.outcome: fasting glucose +0.3 mmol/L (5 mg/dL, p=0.015), insulin sensitivity decreased; fat-free mass increased; intra-abdominal adiposity NOT reduced
nodes.label: Nass 2008 (MK-677, class evidence)

nodes.design: systematic review and meta-regression of case-control studies of circulating IGF-1 and cancer risk (background epidemiology, no secretagogue exposure)
nodes.outcome: IGF-1 75th vs 25th percentile: prostate cancer OR 1.49 (1.14-1.95), premenopausal breast cancer OR 1.65 (1.26-2.08); modest and variable by site
nodes.label: Renehan 2004
Selective - no cortisol or prolactin spike unlike other GHRPs
nodes.verdict: partly supported - rodent basis solid, human claim overstated; '200x ED50' figure unverified

nodes.label: Builds lean muscle / reduces body fat
nodes.verdict: unsupported - never measured in humans; on-target orexigenic effect cuts against fat loss

nodes.label: Improves sleep, recovery, healing, joints, skin
Clinically proven / backed by clinical trials
nodes.verdict: misleading - the one published RCT was negative; a larger one was never reported

nodes.label: Well tolerated in clinical trials
nodes.verdict: supported for <=7 days IV in 117 patients; over-extended to chronic subcutaneous use

nodes.label: FDA-approved / cleared for compounding
nodes.verdict: false - was Category 2; no USP/NF monograph; not on 503A bulks list

nodes.label: Stacks synergistically with CJC-1295
nodes.verdict: hypothesis only - combination never tested in humans

nodes.label: Won't show up on a drug test
